questions.stem: What is the result of reflecting the point (3, 4) across the y-axis?
questions.solution: When reflecting a point across the y-axis, the x-coordinate changes sign while the y-coordinate remains unchanged. So, the reflection of (3, 4) is (-3, 4).
questions.explanation: The y-axis reflection flips the sign of the x-coordinate.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be to also flip the sign of the y-coordinate, which would result in choice A. However, this is incorrect because only the x-coordinate changes sign.

questions.stem: Reflect the point (-5, -7) across the y-axis and identify the coordinates.
questions.solution: The reflection of (-5, -7) across the y-axis is (5, -7), as only the x-coordinate changes sign.
questions.explanation: Remember that reflecting across the y-axis only affects the x-coordinate.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be to think that both coordinates change signs, which would lead to choices B and C. However, this is incorrect; only the x-coordinate should have its sign flipped.

questions.stem: What is the y-coordinate of the point reflected across the y-axis if the original point has coordinates (x, 8)?
questions.solution: The y-coordinate remains unchanged after reflecting across the y-axis. So, it will still be 8.
questions.explanation: Reflection across the y-axis only affects the x-coordinate; the y-coordinate stays the same.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be to think that the y-coordinate changes sign, which would lead to choice A. However, this is incorrect; the y-coordinate remains 8.

questions.stem: Reflect the point (2, -9) across the y-axis and determine the x- coordinate of the reflected point.
questions.solution: The x-coordinate changes sign after reflecting across the y-axis. So, it will be -2.
questions.explanation: Reflection across the y-axis only affects the x- coordinate; its sign is flipped.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake would be to think that the x-coordinate remains unchanged, which would lead to choice C. However, this is incorrect; the x-coordinate should change to -2.

questions.stem: Reflect the point (0, -1) across the y-axis and state the new y- coordinate.
questions.solution: The reflection of (0, -1) across the y-axis is (0, -1), as only the x-coordinate changes sign. The y- coordinate remains -1.
questions.explanation: Reflection across the y-axis does not affect the y-coordinate if it's already at 0.
